an3.72:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an3.72:1.2: Atha kho aññataro ājīvakasāvako gahapati yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so ājīvakasāvako gahapati āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
an3.72:2.1: Kesan no bhante Ānanda dhammo svākkhāto,
an3.72:2.4: Tena hi gahapati tvaṃ yeva ettha paṭipucchissāmi, yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi.
an3.72:2.6: Ye rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti dosassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti mohassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti tesaṃ dhammo svākkhāto no vā
an3.72:2.7: kathaṃ vā te ettha hotī ti?
an3.72:2.8: Ye bhante rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti dosassa . . . pe . . . mohassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti tesaṃ dhammo svākkhāto --
an3.72:3.2: Ye rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā dosassa . . . mohassa pahānāya paṭipanā te loke supaṭipannā no vā
an3.72:3.3: kathaṃ vā te ettha hotī ti?
an3.72:3.4: Ye bhante rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā dosassa . . . mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā te loke supaṭipannā --
an3.72:4.2: Yesaṃ rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, yesaṃ doso pahīno . . . pe . . . yesaṃ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo te loke sugatā no vā
an3.72:4.3: kathaṃ vā te ettha hotī ti?
an3.72:4.4: Yesaṃ bhante rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, yesaṃ doso pahīno . . . pe . . . yesaṃ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo te loke sugatā
an3.72:5.1: Iti kho tayā c' etaṃ vyākataṃ --
an3.72:5.2: ye bhante rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti dosassa . . . pe . . . mohassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desenti tesaṃ dhammo svākkhāto ti. Tayā c'
an3.72:5.4: ye bhante rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā dosassa . . . pe . . . mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā te loke supaṭipannā ti.
an3.72:5.6: yesaṃ bhante rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, yesaṃ doso pahīno . . . pe . . . yesaṃ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo te loke sugatā ti.
an3.72:6.2: Na c' eva nāma sadhammukkaṃsanā bhavissati na paradhammāpasādanā
an3.72:6.3: āyatane va dhammadesanā attho ca vutto attā ca anupaṇīto. 5.
an3.72:6.4: Tumhe bhante Ānanda rāgassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desetha dosassa pahānāya . . . pe . . . mohassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desetha,
an3.72:6.6: Tumhe bhante Ānanda rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā dosassa . . . pe . . . mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā,
an3.72:6.8: Tumhākaṃ bhante Ānanda rāgo pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo, tumhākaṃ doso . . . pe . . . tumhākaṃ moho pahīno ucchinnamūlo tālāvatthukato anabhāvakato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo,
an3.72:7.2: Seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam evaṃ ayyena Ānandena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an3.72:7.3: Esāhaṃ bhante Ānanda Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca.
an3.72:7.4: Upāsakam maṃ ayyo Ānando dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
